name: Binemon
fix_description: Add access control (onlyOwner) or a cooldown period to sweepTokenForMarketing(). Currently anyone can call it repeatedly in one tx to dump all contract tokens at progressively worse prices, crashing the token price for front-running.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct sequence: repeatedly call an externally accessible token function to alter token state, buy the token, let another user buy to move price, then sell. It involves only basic token/router interactions with no flash loan, no complex multi-contract logic, and an obvious access-control/economic design issue.
